dimensions.summary: The Home Dataset bridge exposes only opaque catalog refs and follows at most two declared same-Dataset relations while longer paths fail closed.
Context policy, typed tool contract, Dataset service and acceptance ledger agree on one two-edge maximum with no renderer or SQL authority.
PIGE-DATA-002 remains partial while its evidence now covers deterministic one-hop and two-hop relation queries, invalid-hop rejection and restart parity.
The existing Dataset query service and relation core absorb the bounded path extension without a new IPC channel, durable format or public query language.
Existing context-policy, decision, playbook and trace owners contain the feature without introducing another design document.

verification.evidence: The bounded two-hop query, invented-hop rejection, restart parity, citation/result integrity and real Home tool contract pass together.
